interface.name: openos_workspace_manager_v1
interface.description: 客户端绑定后, 合成器为每个工作区发送一个 workspace 事件 (new_id), 随后跟随 name / state / done 事件描述该工作区。

event.name: workspace
event.description: Emitted for every workspace when the client binds the manager. The workspace is described by subsequent events.

interface.name: openos_workspace_handle_v1
interface.description: Represents one workspace. The client can request to activate it.

description.summary: all workspace info has been sent
request that this workspace be activated
